title: A Review of the Role of Causality in Developing Trustworthy AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing causal mediation analysis to investigate bias in neural network components (like neurons and attention heads) and surveying counterfactual fairness definitions using structural causal models.
Surveying causal explanation formulas to decompose discrimination into direct, indirect, and spurious effects, and reviewing interventional and path-specific counterfactual fairness frameworks.

Analyzing pre-processing, in-processing, and post-processing causal fairness frameworks (e.g., data manipulation, causal feature selection, and counterfactual equalized odds) that intervene on sensitive attributes to measure and mitigate discrimination.
